cr_data.provenance:
(An American Place, New York, NY, 1930). (With The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY, as “Green Hills Painted Red”). Private collection, Brockton, MA, by 1950. (Sale: Sotheby’s Parke Bernet, New York, NY, December 13, 1973, lot. 21). (Andrew Crispo Gallery, New York, NY, by 1973, no. AC74-06). Gilbert H. [1931–2021] and Ann Kinney, Washington, DC, by 1974. (Barbara Divver, New York, NY, by 1984). Graham [1940–2025] and Ann Gund, Cambridge, MA, by 1985. (With Richard York Gallery, New York, NY). (Hirschl & Adler Galleries, New York, NY, by 1985, no. 11909D); probably sold to private collection, Winnetka, IL then St. Petersburg, FL, 1985; given to the Museum of Fine Arts, St. Petersburg, FL, May 5, 2010. 
(Source: Museum of Fine Arts, St. Petersburg, 2025)

description: Two sloping hills stand on either side of the composition, creating a U-shaped gap through which another, taller hill is visible. All three are dotted with dark green bushes. Flat land runs below the hills. Above this red and brown landscape, white clouds sweep across a pale blue sky.
